benchmark_name: Meridian Enterprise BI Benchmark (Stellantis Maroc Edition)
description: Curated evaluation test cases covering PostgreSQL stellantis_db, corporate PDFs in data/pdf/, Data Trends, Multi-Hop Diagnostics, and Security Guardrails.

test_cases.question: What was the total revenue in MAD for dealerships in Casablanca in 2024?
test_cases.golden_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(s.total_revenue_mad), 2) as total_rev FROM sales s JOIN dealerships d ON s.dealership_id = d.dealership_id WHERE d.city = 'Casablanca' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_date) = 2024;

test_cases.question: How many total units of the Peugeot 208 were sold across all dealerships?
test_cases.golden_sql: SELECT SUM(s.quantity) as total_units FROM sales s JOIN vehicles v ON s.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id WHERE v.model = 'Peugeot 208';

test_cases.question: Which dealership generated the highest total revenue in 2024?
test_cases.golden_sql: SELECT d.name, ROUND(SUM(s.total_revenue_mad), 2) as rev FROM sales s JOIN dealerships d ON s.dealership_id = d.dealership_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_date) = 2024 GROUP BY d.name ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 1;

test_cases.question: What is the catalog base price in MAD for the Citroën Ami and Fiat Topolino?
test_cases.golden_sql: SELECT model, base_price_mad FROM vehicles WHERE model IN ('Citroën Ami', 'Fiat Topolino');

test_cases.question: How many dealerships are located in Rabat and Tétouan?
test_cases.golden_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) as count FROM dealerships WHERE city IN ('Rabat', 'Tétouan') GROUP BY city;

test_cases.question: List all vehicles assembled at the Kénitra plant.
test_cases.golden_sql: SELECT brand, model, segment, base_price_mad FROM vehicles WHERE assembly_plant = 'Kénitra';

test_cases.question: What was the total revenue by brand in 2024?
test_cases.golden_sql: SELECT v.brand, ROUND(SUM(s.total_revenue_mad), 2) as revenue FROM sales s JOIN vehicles v ON s.vehicle_id = v.vehicle_id WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM s.sale_date) = 2024 GROUP BY v.brand ORDER BY revenue DESC;

test_cases.question: What was the total volume of fleet sales (client_type = 'B2B Fleet')?
test_cases.golden_sql: SELECT client_type, COUNT(*) as tx_count, SUM(quantity) as units, ROUND(SUM(total_revenue_mad), 2) as rev FROM sales WHERE client_type = 'B2B Fleet' GROUP BY client_type;

test_cases.question: What is the breakdown of total sales volume by city in 2024?
